description: Project-generated unique identifier for each sampled ED visit.
modelling_role: Identifier/analysis metadata; exclude from ML features

description: Calendar month of the visit (1–12).
Day of week of the visit.
ED arrival time in HHMM format.
Hour of ED arrival (0–23), derived from arrival_time.
Minutes from ED arrival to first physician/APRN/PA contact.
Total length of the ED visit in minutes.
modelling_role: Post-arrival outcome; exclude from wait prediction

description: Patient age in years; age 94 includes patients aged 94 and over.
Patient-reported pain score from 0 to 10.
Arrival pulse in beats per minute.
Arrival respiratory rate in breaths per minute.
Arrival systolic blood pressure in mmHg.
Arrival diastolic blood pressure in mmHg.
Arrival pulse oximetry percentage.
Number of recorded chronic conditions.
Number of diagnoses recorded for the visit.
modelling_role: Post-arrival outcome; exclude from wait prediction

description: Number of procedures recorded for the visit.
modelling_role: Post-arrival outcome; exclude from wait prediction

description: NHAMCS survey weight used to estimate national visit totals.
modelling_role: Identifier/analysis metadata; exclude from ML features

description: Arrival temperature in degrees Fahrenheit.
Patient sex recorded as Female or Male in the source file.
Patient residence category before the visit.
Whether the patient arrived by ambulance.
Whether an ambulance arrival was transferred from another facility.
Recorded urgency category assigned during ED triage.
CDC reason-for-visit classification code.
Primary ICD diagnosis code recorded for the visit.
modelling_role: Post-arrival outcome; exclude from wait prediction
